references.text: The verses describe respectively the command to and the fulfillment of returning the silver that was placed back in the sacks.
Verse 44:8 is the direct rhetorical confirmation of the action described in 43:21, used as proof of innocence.
Describes the same miraculous phenomenon (silver in the sack) at two different times during the same journey.
The verse describes the departure with the silver, while the source verse confirms that they took it with them.
